title: Gloves of Power

sources.title: Absolute's Bane
markers: | description = On a hit with a weapon attack, possibly inflict a {{DieIcon|d4|Slashing}} '''-1d4''' penalty to the target's {{Attack Roll}}s and {{SavingThrow}}s.

summary: Gain +1 Sleight of Hand. With the Absolute’s Brand, weapon hits can apply Bane.

fields.Absolute’s Bane: A melee or ranged weapon hit forces a DC 11 Charisma save. On failure, −1d4 to attack rolls and saves for 2 turns. Does not stack with another Bane. Source reports it fails while disguised.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported save behavior: The Charisma save against Absolute’s Bane is hidden in the combat log and does not prompt Portent.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
